blocks.x: How KYC Management System is built: controlled model serving, retention discipline and regulator-ready verification logs.

The platform runs document and face models in a controlled serving environment; no applicant data trains shared models. Data retention follows your jurisdiction's rules, and reviewer actions are logged end to end.

items: Verification models run inside your perimeter
Applicant data is never used to train external models
Documents and biometric data kept per policy, then purged
Complete verification trails, exportable on demand
